bm25.title: Visitor Hours Policy
bm25.text: Visitors are welcome between 10:00 and 20:00. A maximum of two visitors per patient at the bedside at any time. Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult.

dense.title: Visitor Hours Policy
dense.text: Visitors are welcome between 10:00 and 20:00. A maximum of two visitors per patient at the bedside at any time. Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult.

dense.title: Medication Reconciliation at Transitions of Care
dense.text: Target: 95% of admissions reconciled within 24 hours.

dense.title: Adult Sepsis Screening and Escalation Protocol
dense.text: Escalate when infection is suspected AND two or more of: respiratory rate 22 per minute or higher, altered mental status, systolic blood pressure 100 mmHg or lower, or a lactate of 2 mmol/L or higher.
